annotations.text:
Visualisazcy — full app

Infinite pan/zoom board, palette left, inspector right, story timeline below.
Tokens lifted from src/theme.js; card anatomy matches src/render.js at scale 1
(168x62, r12, 34px badge, 3px meter).

The inspector is new — properties are only editable as JSON today.
Wiring segmented control is the existing role: gives / takes / both.

Export is not built yet. Shown here because timelines are already
deterministic, which is what makes frame-sequence render possible.
